test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: U,V, W, X,Y and Z are sitting in a row facing towards North (but not necessarily in the same order). Z is sitting second to the right of V and immediate left of Y. Only one person is sitting between U and V. W is not the immediate neighbor of U. Who is sitting at second position from the right end?
solution:
Given:-

Six people → U, V, W, X, Y and Z are sitting in a row facing north.

1) Z is sitting second to the right of V ans immediate left of V.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f01c600ae29df381acf06676493eeebd7e9b60d3f5c90c8f1e431708a33eb8ba.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fa28bf149eec6e318ea06a963c4f60707351b248f48627b343b38a200591b60c.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a25c1b3a65445190d7b79bd2536a8e8f578277ac29305960f19fad5cec5273d5.png] 

2) Only one person is sitting between U and V.

Case 1 → Not possible as position at which U could be placed is already occupied by Z.

Case 2 → Not possible as only position is empty to the left of V and to the right of V the position is already occupied by Z.

Case 3:-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/48068ad02862e8230ad48e90996dc20dc10ce7ade182ed4bc411df80ed43f41c.png] 

3) W is not an immediate neighbour of U.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c3157f5b63f71f511d83e185b8b81e7abe3e4ce1c82da61d072d241d48e9f6a8.png] 

4) The only position left will be occupied by X.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0843b189f512771c20a6678cb7e95263cb34a24291605b8013a9965406166d1a.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Z".**
